descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. As an Automation Business Partner: you will be focused on managing projects to automate business processes. You will assess new use cases, map processes and discuss potential process improvements. Additionally, you will support the automation global product owner managing the project and solution portfolios and optimizing the resource utilization. You will interface with stakeholders to ensure that current and future needs are identified in a timely manner. The Opportunity:
• University/College education (preferably Business, Business Informatics, Engineering or similar) and 1–2 years’ experience in customer service-related roles, with strong English communication skills (additional languages an asset) and comfort working autonomously in virtual, global teams.
• Strong customer-oriented mindset with high accountability and results/goal orientation: takes ownership of end-to-end resolution, manages multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment, and maintains composure, persistence, and proactivity.
• Good understanding of IT solution components, their interactions, and data flows; familiarity with Q2C/O2C management processes and workflows; ITIL Service Management knowledge and/or experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) strongly preferred.
• Excellent organizational and communication skills, able to prioritize tasks and produce clear, well-structured documentation; co-create in a complex, team-oriented global environment with strong cultural awareness and intercultural communication skills.
• High learning agility with the ability to develop cross-departmental skills, comply with process requirements and all relevant laws/regulations, and consistently demonstrate resourcefulness, autonomy, and a strong drive for continuous improvement. Who you are:
• Fluent in English with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, communication, stakeholder and change management, project management, and the ability to influence without authority while navigating a complex, global matrix organization with an entrepreneurial, highly accountable, and agile mindset.
• Able to work in a self-aligning, agile team environment, prioritizing effectively, making independent decisions, and translating business requirements into Analytics & AI (A&AI) specifications.
• Strong system skills, including understanding of ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA a plus) and advanced hands-on experience leading RPA projects (must), plus at least one of the following: Google Apps Script, SAP Scripting, AppSheet, AWS, GCP or VBA.
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline (preferred), with 5+ years of relevant experience delivering automation projects at a regional/global level; experience in Global Business Services (GBS) is a plus. Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solut
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. As an Automation Business Partner: you will be focused on managing projects to automate business processes. You will assess new use cases, map processes and discuss potential process improvements. Additionally, you will support the automation global product owner managing the project and solution portfolios and optimizing the resource utilization. You will interface with stakeholders to ensure that current and future needs are identified in a timely manner. The Opportunity:
• Lead the end-to-end implementation of automation solutions from idea assessment through design, deployment, testing, operation, adoption monitoring and retirement, including the creation of clear business cases, process designs, requirements and status reports.
• Support the global product owner in prioritizing initiatives and allocating resources, keeping the project and solution portfolio up to date, driving adoption of existing solutions and decommissioning deprecated ones in line with team OKRs.
• Keep the project and solution portfolio up to date to facilitate decision-making, monitor usage of existing solutions, and work closely with automation business analysts and automation developers to support the design, deployment, testing, and operational phases.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and act as a liaison between business lines, automation teams, and other departments to ensure regular information exchange (e.g. strategic priorities, upcoming process changes, events, pain points, etc).
• Proactively generate demand for new automation use cases and foster an innovative mindset in the organization by leading workshops, brainstorming sessions, awareness campaigns, and continuous process improvement. Who you are:
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is required, paired with 5+ years of experience in a GBS or affiliate working on regional/global projects and automation/AI initiatives.
• Advanced experience creating/leading projects using RPA tools (must) and at least one of the following: Google Apps Scripts, SAP Scripting, AppSheet, AWS, GCP, and VBA, alongside an understanding of ERP systems (experience with SAP S4/HANA is a plus).
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to translate business requirements into Automation & AI specifications, plus experience in Project Management, Agile, and/or Lean methodologies is a plus.
• Strong communicator (especially to senior management) with proven stakeholder management and change management capability.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and has demonstrated flexibility to work in an agile, self-aligning team environment where independent decision-making and creative mindsets are valued. Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
